items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1968-11-30
items.q: I played with a fellow named Dan. He was a guitar player. And he used to have a four-piece band... That was the first job that I remember playing with him.

ctx.x: Well, let's talk a little bit about your very early days of the band. What were the very, very first jobs you played?

Well, the first jobs I played, I played with a fellow named Dan. He was a guitar player. And he used to have a four-piece band, go out on the lake on Sundays. That was most of his work. Every Sunday he'd have a departure train that was lit up at little, uh, uh, places out there that was dancing. You know, what they called, uh, regular dancing places, you know, camps. You know, camps, you know, out in the water, about, some of them out there about, probably a block of air. Go out on the run, man, and porch all…
What sort of music would that play?
